text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I pass by a takoyaki stand while I'm out
shopping,
when suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Craving a quick snack?! You look like
you're
hankering for something good!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I've got just the thing for
you—takoyaki!
Don't you worry, they're
masterfully made with
my acupuncturing
skills! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With practiced hands, she quickly whips
up some
takoyaki, filling the air with a
mouthwatering
scent.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait for just the right moment annnd...
poke! ☆
Heavens, just look at that color,
that luster!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
See, they're absolutely irresistible! ☆

Acupuncture truly is applicable to
anything and
everything!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Both cooking and medical treatment
require a
similar level of care! (I think.)
How wonderful that
I can hone my art
while earning an extra buck on
the side!
choice_data_list: たこ焼きと笹針にどんな関係が……？
choice_data_list_en: What do takoyaki and acupuncture have to do with each other...?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
The days I spent flipping takoyaki while

frantically dodging hot oil...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
And that one time I got yelled at for
burning a
whole batch... Why, those
days are well behind
me!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Come now—have a taste of the fruit of
my
labors! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accept the piping hot takoyaki, pop
one in my
mouth... and the harmonious
combination of
chewy dough and
octopus fills my senses!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, looks like it was to your liking. It was worth using my needles, then. No worries, I used the ones I keep exclusively for making takoyaki!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna churn out more while I'm still
in the
groove! Woohoo, mass
production! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her needle technique is exquisite... Maybe she can be trusted after all... Maybe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I accept the piping hot takoyaki, pop
one in my
mouth... and am immediately
disappointed. There
doesn't seem to be
any octopus inside.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, no way... Don't tell me I forgot to
put
octopus in this whole batch?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sasami Anshinzawa gets an earful from
the stall
owner afterwards.
